effectSummary.ko: 중독과 둔화가 동시에 걸린 적에게 일반 액티브 직접 피해가 가산 12% 증가합니다. 빙결만으로 둔화가 있다고 간주하지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: Gain +12% additive normal-active direct damage against enemies that are both poisoned and slowed. Freeze alone does not imply Slow.

productionConcept: An enduring poison-and-slow synergy emblem: a thick emerald venom fang intertwined with a broad blue-white frost crystal, meeting at one silver barb. Clearly distinct interlocking green organic and icy angular halves, compact solid silhouette with transparent inner gap.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone HELLSCRIPT Ranger skill icon. Create one original square 1024 x 1024 PNG with genuine native transparent alpha. Surrounding and internal empty space must be fully transparent. Style: painterly dark gothic fantasy, worn iron, aged leather, bone and muted bronze, sculptural chiaroscuro, crisp broad highlights, dark solid midtones, restrained brush texture. Large readable forms, limited detail, strong shape distinction at 64px. Entire subject including glow and particles must fit inside central 76% of canvas, leaving at least 12% fully transparent margin on all four sides. No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, icon frame, medallion rim, UI panel, floor, cast shadow, scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard or matte. Do not bake any background; preserve native alpha. Use restrained cohesive effects rather than clouds of tiny particles.  Internal identity (do not render text): AP15 Venom and Frost. Skill type: passive. Effect: Gain +12% additive normal-active direct damage against enemies that are both poisoned and slowed. Freeze alone does not imply Slow. Tags: Passive. Linked equipment IDs for identity context only: LA03, LA17, LA18, LA19, LA20, LA21, LA22, LA26, DES_LA42, DES_LA44. Subject and composition: An enduring poison-and-slow synergy emblem: a thick emerald venom fang intertwined with a broad blue-white frost crystal, meeting at one silver barb. Clearly distinct interlocking green organic and icy angular halves, compact solid silhouette with transparent inner gap. FINAL FRAMING REQUIREMENT: a small isolated icon floating in extensive fully transparent empty space. Fit ALL visible content inside a centered square occupying only 60% of total canvas width and height; leave 20% absolutely empty transparent margins. Output resolution must be exactly 1024 by 1024 pixels.
